title: The chapel and the Tankard, ruined properly
changes: The ruined Chapel of the Dawn now looks like a chapel: buttressed corners, tall pointed windows, a rose window in the broken gable and shattered stained glass on the east side.
Fallen carved stones, roof slates and a charred beam lie all around the chapel.
The Rusty Tankard's burnt frame is redrawn: split, charred posts, burnt-off planks, fallen rafters and drifts of ash.
